cards.text: Seventh letter, last one, baker (Revelation 1:11). Jesus has a message for the angel of the church in Laodicea. He opens by calling Himself "the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation."

cards.question: Jesus tells the church in Laodicea, "I know your deeds," and then He gives them a temperature check. What does He say they are?

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "How I wish you were one or the other!" They're lukewarm, friend, like a cookie pulled out halfway through the timer: not dough, not done, just CONFUSED.

cards.question: Because the church in Laodicea is lukewarm, what does Jesus say He is about to do?

answers.text: Vomit them out of His mouth

cards.text: Now Jesus quotes Laodicea back to itself: "I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing." Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, and even I never got bold enough to say I need NOTHING.

cards.question: Laodicea thinks it's rich. But Jesus says they don't realize they're actually ___.

cards.text: Poor is just the start. Jesus says they're also wretched, pitiful, blind and naked, and He counsels them to buy three things from Him.

cards.question: Laodicea is poor. What does Jesus counsel them to buy from Him so they can become rich?
Laodicea is naked. Jesus counsels them to buy white garments from Him so they can be ___ and their shameful nakedness won't be exposed.
Jesus also says Laodicea is blind. So He counsels them to buy salve to anoint their eyes so they can see.
Jesus has just told Laodicea some hard things. Who does He say He rebukes and disciplines?
So Jesus tells the church in Laodicea to be earnest and repent.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "Behold, I stand at the door and knock." Lean in for this one, friend.

cards.question: Jesus is knocking at the door. He says only the leaders of the church can open it to Him.
Jesus is knocking. If anyone hears His voice and opens the door, what does He say He will do?

answers.text: Come in and dine with them
Talk with them at the door
Walk with them down the road

cards.text: Now comes a promise for the one who overcomes. Hold on to your apron, baker, because this one is BIG.

cards.question: What does Jesus promise to the one in Laodicea who overcomes?

answers.text: The right to sit with Him on His throne
A home inside the new Jerusalem
A crown of twelve shining stars

cards.text: Jesus says it's just as He overcame and sat down with His Father on His throne. Then the seventh letter ends: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
